record.original_question: Let X be a non-empty class of finite groups of odd order closed under taking subgroups, homomorphic images, and extensions. Let H be an X-maximal subgroup of a finite group G, and N a normal subgroup of G. Must H ∩ N be an X-maximal subgroup of N?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathfrak{X}$ be a non-empty class of finite groups all of whose members have odd order, and assume that $\mathfrak{X}$ is closed under taking subgroups, homomorphic images, and extensions (i.e., if $1\to A\to B\to C\to 1$ is a short exact sequence of finite groups with $A,C\in\mathfrak{X}$, then $B\in\mathfrak{X}$).

For a finite group $G$, a subgroup $H\le G$ is called $\mathfrak{X}$-maximal in $G$ if $H\in\mathfrak{X}$ and $H$ is not properly contained in any larger subgroup of $G$ that lies in $\mathfrak{X}$.

Let $G$ be a finite group, let $H$ be an $\mathfrak{X}$-maximal subgroup of $G$, and let $N$ be a normal subgroup of $G$. Determine whether $H\cap N$ is necessarily an $\mathfrak{X}$-maximal subgroup of $N$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as a new entry in the most recent (2026) edition of the Kourovka Notebook of unsolved problems in group theory. It is closely related to the classical Wielandt–Hartley theorem on intersections of π-maximal subgroups with subnormal subgroups, but the specific question for general odd-order subgroup-, quotient-, and extension-closed classes does not appear to have a published resolution. No solution was located in the literature search.

status_evidence.title: Unsolved Problems in Group Theory. The Kourovka Notebook
status_evidence.snippet: Compendium of unsolved problems in group theory, including questions on X-maximal and π-maximal subgroups.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is listed among open problems in the Kourovka Notebook tradition.

status_evidence.title: Classification and properties of the π-submaximal subgroups in minimal nonsolvable groups
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Wielandt–Hartley theorem and π-maximal subgroups in normal subgroups.
status_evidence.claim: Related Wielandt–Hartley results address intersections of π-maximal subgroups with subnormal subgroups but do not resolve the stated question for general odd-order classes.
